product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides an autonomous-company runtime that deploys AI employees to build and operate new businesses or automate functions for existing businesses connected to their stack.
product_one_liner.notes: Naïve describes itself as an autonomous company runtime, says it deploys AI employees to execute work, and distinguishes new companies from existing companies that connect their stack.

pricing_page.notes: Naïve has a first-party pricing page that states plan pricing and metered usage.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Naïve company/job page names Airwallex and HackerRank among companies where it is deployed. | named_customers.0: Airwallex is named among companies where Naïve is deployed. | named_customers.1: HackerRank is named among companies where Naïve is deployed.

employee_band.notes: YC reports a team size of 12, which falls within the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Dealroom explicitly gives the headquarters as San Francisco, and YC also lists San Francisco as the company location. A funding-release description calls the lab Palo Alto-based, so the city is supported by the company profile but has a minor source-location discrepancy. | hq_country: Dealroom identifies the company headquarters as San Francisco, United States; this supplies the country.

founded_year.notes: YC lists Naïve as founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index reports one Engineering post; its Engineering section contains a single post dated April 8, 2026. Under the requested threshold, one engineering post is not enough.

public_docs.notes: The public Naïve docs portal includes an agent/session reference and multiple linked API, SDK, CLI, capability, and concepts documentation pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current YC jobs index lists six roles, and none of the titles is an AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or other qualifying AI/ML title under the stated criteria.

model_provider.value: OpenRouter-backed routing to 300+ models, including models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Mistral.
model_provider.notes: The product documentation explicitly calls Naïve’s LLM routing OpenRouter-backed and lists the model providers it routes across.

compliance_certs.notes: The full first-party security page discusses security practices and says provider attestations are available upon request, but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The August 2026 funding announcement identifies the round as Series A. | funding_date: The announced latest round is dated August 6, 2026, so its month is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The funding announcement dated August 6, 2026 states that Naïve announced a $28.5 million Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: Naïve announced a $28.5 million Series A on August 6, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current YC jobs list shows six open roles, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The company blog lists a new agent music primitive as a launch dated November 2, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current YC founders listing names Sean Dorje (CEO) and Dennis Zax (CTO); their profiles show Naïve roles beginning in April 2025 and January 2025, both before the 12-month window. No C-level or VP-level join/departure announcement was located; this negative is based on the available team and profile evidence.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Naïve’s sales page says leads, replies, and bookings can be pushed directly to HubSpot, Notion, or Airtable. | crm_stack_signal.0: The sales page explicitly names HubSpot as a direct CRM-sync destination. | crm_stack_signal.1: The sales page explicitly names Notion as a direct CRM-sync destination. | crm_stack_signal.2: The sales page explicitly names Airtable as a direct CRM-sync destination.
